scenes.narration: Northern California, 1968. A shadowy figure emerges, beginning a reign of terror that would baffle investigators for decades.
scenes.image_prompt: Foggy night in Benicia, a lone car parked by a deserted road.
scenes.camera: Wide shot slowly zooming in on the car.

scenes.narration: December 1968. The first confirmed Zodiac attack leaves two teenagers dead, marking the start of a chilling pattern.
scenes.image_prompt: Police tape fluttering in the wind near a bloodstained car.
scenes.camera: Close-up of the tape, then pan to the car.

scenes.narration: July 1969. The Zodiac strikes again, claiming another life and leaving a survivor who would never forget.
scenes.image_prompt: A dimly lit parking lot, a wounded man crawling for help.
scenes.camera: Handheld, shaky cam to convey urgency.

scenes.narration: September 1969. Lake Berryessa becomes the site of a brazen daylight attack, shocking the community.
scenes.image_prompt: A serene lakeside scene disrupted by a figure in a black hood.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the lake, then sudden close-up of the figure.

scenes.narration: October 1969. San Francisco. A cab driver becomes the Zodiac's final confirmed victim.
scenes.image_prompt: A taxi idling on a quiet city street, shadowy figure approaching.

scenes.narration: The Zodiac begins a twisted game, sending cryptic letters and ciphers to the press, taunting authorities.
scenes.image_prompt: A close-up of a gloved hand sealing an envelope with a zodiac symbol.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up, shallow depth of field.

scenes.narration: Decades pass, but the 340-character cipher remains unsolved, a maddening puzzle from beyond the grave.
scenes.image_prompt: A dusty desk covered in decoded papers and magnifying glasses.
scenes.camera: Overhead shot slowly panning across the documents.

scenes.narration: The Zodiac Killer's identity remains a mystery, his legacy a dark stain on American crime history.
scenes.image_prompt: A wall covered in suspect photos and red string, fading into darkness.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot along the wall, then pull back.
